limitations: Five independently date-filtered Exa discovery queries cover publication-month search scopes January–May 2026; these are research activity, not claims about all interviews or interview dates. Each returned result is dispositioned in the corresponding campaign.
The admitted original does not state job country; location is Not stated, not United States inferred from query or India inferred from author profile.

Meghana Adiga supplies seven Leadership Principle themes but not concrete question wording or per-round assignments; themes and unnamed LP counts are not expanded into invented questions. OA and phone-screen problems are excluded.
Original source metadata provides publication date, not an interview date. Search-index dates and syndication dates do not replace original interview chronology.
No authentication/paywall bypass. Gated mirrors, missing candidate attribution and ambiguous screen/final-loop boundaries remain unresolved rather than weakening supplemental admission.
